title: docs(skills): teach the lookupFilters { $record } reference and orEmpty
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB5crsrYoZ5Eg3aoQQucQsHv)_

Fixes #34201

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack-data` 技能的 `rules/field-types.md` 和两页数据建模文档（`relationships.mdx`、`fields.mdx`）开始教 lookup 筛选里的 `{ $record }` 引用和 `orEmpty`：引用怎么写、引用值为空时这条筛选被略过、`orEmpty` 及它能搭配的六个运算符、它和 `dependsOn` 的区别。
- 为什么改：这两个写法的读取方（表单里的记录选择器）已随 PR #34253 落地，规范里的「PLANNED」标记已摘掉，但技能和文档一个字都没提，AI 和作者不知道可以这样按当前记录筛选候选项。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档和技能文字，不动产品代码；技能文件原本零余量，先删了同文件 5 处重复（179 字节），再把该文件的 token 上限按实测从 3349 提到 3553（+204）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` 第 210–234 行（新教学）和第 42、132、254、264 行（删掉的重复）；`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 里 `field-types.md` 那一行上限及其注释；`content/docs/data-modeling/relationships.mdx` 第 44–83 行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep field-types`，预期看到 `3553 / 3553 (+0)`，末行 ✓。
- 需要你做的：审阅并合并（改了 `skills/**`，属于需要你亲手合并的受管面）。

## Liveness readings (the premise, measured at `9e6fee19`)

The card says to teach only once the reader lands. Both shapes are read today, so both are taught:

- `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, row `lookupFilters`: `status: live`, `verifiedAt: 2026-11-16`. Its note names the readers: `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupRecordReference.ts#resolveLookupFilters` puts the value of the record being edited in place of each `{ $record }` reference, only on a field a record form stamped through `withRecordBeingEdited`, and leaves out an entry whose value is empty or cannot be read; `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RecordPickerDialog.tsx#lookupFiltersToRecord` sends `orEmpty: true` as an `$or` with a `$null` match on the same column.
- Both files exist at `9e6fee19` and carry those functions (`git log` names the landing commit `2c296cf2`, PR #34253). `RecordPickerDialog.tsx` line 267 builds `{ $or: [{ [f.field]: condition }, { [f.field]: { $null: true } }] }`.
- `[PLANNED — not enforced]` markers: `grep -c PLANNED packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` answers 0; the `value`, `orEmpty` and `lookupFilters` describes say what the picker does. No spec marker is left to flip.
- Before this PR: `grep -c -E '\$record|orEmpty'` answers 0 in each of the three target files (control: 36 hits in `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`).
- The six operators are copied from `LOOKUP_FILTER_SCALAR_COMPARISONS` in `field.zod.ts`: `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `gte`, `lte`.
- The path check the docs page mentions (`os validate` refuses a path that names no field) is `object-field-ref-unknown` in `packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts`, severity `error`.

## What changes

**`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`** (§ Lookup). The section's one example becomes a quote's `price_book` lookup with a literal entry, a `{ $record: 'quote_date' }` entry and a one-hop `{ $record: 'account.market' }` entry, both with `orEmpty: true`. One paragraph under it carries the four points: the reference is the whole `value` and pairs, like `orEmpty`, only with the six operators; only a record form resolves it and every other picker host leaves the entry out; an empty or unreadable value drops the entry; `orEmpty: true` also matches a null column; a `$record` field is not also listed in `dependsOn`, which would add an equality filter. It ends with the limit the spec states: the picker only narrows the choice.

**`content/docs/data-modeling/relationships.mdx`** gains `#### Filter by the record being edited` under Filtered Lookups: the shape, one example (the same price-book case, with both date bounds), and five short bullets (the reference, where it resolves, an empty value, `orEmpty`, `dependsOn` or `$record`).

**`content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`**: one more lookup in the relationship example, the `lookupFilters` row of the property table names `orEmpty` and the reference, a `dependsOn` row is added, and a short `#### Lookup filters that read the record being edited` section states the four points and links to the relationships page.

**`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`**: the `field-types.md` row moves 3349 → 3553, with its row comment (next section).

### The ceiling raise: cuts first, then the measured remainder

`field-types.md` sat at zero headroom (3349 / 3349), so any teaching reds the ratchet. The standing ruling, verbatim and untranslated: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 (maintainer, 2026-10-27), the gate-recognised path per ruling record 6513306068 (letter B). The skills seat accepted the row edit as an in-scope widening for this card.

Five same-file restatements are cut, 179 bytes. Each fact is still carried by the sentence named:

| Cut | Bytes | Still carried by |
|:---|---:|:---|
| `secret` row: "**The recommended type for credentials**" | 41 | the `password` row, line 41: "Prefer `secret` for credentials" |
| `autonumber` row: "({0000} counter + optional date / {field} tokens, resets per scope)", now "(→ Autonumber)" | 51 | § Autonumber: the token table (lines 254–256) and line 258, the paragraph that opens "The counter resets per" |
| `autonumber` row: the second `format` example, `"AD{YYYYMMDD}{0000}"` | 24 | the token table, line 255: `AD{YYYYMMDD}{0000}` → `AD202606170001` |
| Autonumber rule 3: "Size it for readability, not as a ceiling." | 43 | the same rule's heading, line 264: "Pad width is a MINIMUM, not a cap" |
| token table, `{0000}` row: "(**minimum** width)" | 20 | rule 3, line 264 |

The teaching adds 994 bytes; net +815 bytes. `wc -c` = 14210 → `ceil(14210 / 4)` = 3553 tokens. The row is pinned at the measurement, zero headroom, +204, and no other row moves.

## Why

The `{ $record }` reference and `orEmpty` were declared ahead of their reader and marked PLANNED; the docs half waited on the picker. The picker landed in PR #34253, so an author can now filter a lookup's candidates by the record being edited, and nothing an AI builder reads said so.

## Tests

None owed: prose in two docs pages and one published skill file, and one data row in a gate script's map. No tested behaviour changes, so no ablation. The gate script's own suite is its `--self-test` (104 cases pass); no `*.test.*` file names it (`git grep -l check-skills-token-ratchet -- '*.test.ts' '*.test.mjs'` is empty).

## Acceptance notes

- **No eval case.** `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` has 20 cases and none covers lookup filters (`grep -c lookupFilters` answers 0), so by the order none is added here.
- **File surface.** The claim lists the two docs pages, the skill file and the optional eval file. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is one more file, accepted by the seat before the push; the changeset is the fifth path.
- **Attribution thread link.** The order prints the seat thread's link; this body carries this card thread's link, the one the session's attribution rule names. Same project, same requester.
- **Not touched, noted only.** `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx` also describes `lookupFilters` and dependent lookups and does not mention `{ $record }`. It is outside the card's three files. carrier: none.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/skills` patch (`.changeset/34201-skills-lookup-filter-record-reference.md`), both declaration lines in it.
- Out-of-scope findings: none. Security findings: none.

## Verification

Head `09f66fe6` on `origin/main` `9e6fee19`. Main has since moved to `ec6b5fd3`; none of the four edited files changed there (`git diff --stat 9e6fee19 ec6b5fd3` over them is empty), so the branch was not re-merged.

**Derived set:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the committed change set → 88 commands. Each ran in this worktree at `09f66fe6`, exit codes captured before any pipe; `--ran`: "88 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 87 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` → exit 0: "57 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings"; `field-types.md` 3553 / 3553.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 104 cases pass.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` → exit 0, 347 prose examples type-check (after the `@objectstack/client-react...` and `@objectstack/lint...` closure build under the verify lock, VERDICT command-exit 0, 310 s).
- `pnpm check:doc-anchors` → exit 0, 1042 internal fragment links resolve (the new `relationships#filter-by-the-record-being-edited` link among them).
- `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:skill-links`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` → exit 0 each.
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, "PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output, and some package has no dist/". It needs a full `pnpm build`, which this diff does not otherwise owe (no package source moved); CI's build lanes carry it.

Not run locally, CI's own: `pnpm lint` (repo-wide), the type-check lanes, `Test Core`, `Build Core`. No package test is owed: no package source moved.

`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: governed, 1 of 5 paths (`skills/**`), landing tier H; 127 changed lines.
